name: INWI Hot Spot, 25 May 1998 (Hour 4)

date.source: The document's own header ("HOT SPOT!!! HOUR NUMBER FOUR!!!! Toledo, Ohio LIVE!!!") and posting date.

no_appearances_reason: Chronology extension only, not a structuring pass -- a dedicated follow-up structuring lane is recommended for this wing given the volume of surviving 1998 material (~140+ sampled card-script posts, more unread), and this single document was deliberately not exhausted into full appearances/matches so that decision is not pre-empted. "King" Apples (mr-apples-inwi, already on file) wins a singles match; Commissioner Jerry DeLuise (jerry-deluise-inwi, if already minted -- check at structuring time) strips Armand Robicheaux of the (World) Television Championship for a missed title defense and orders a 16-man battle royal, won by Mike Hickden (not yet minted) for the vacant title; the bracket for the annual Ringmaster tournament (running to the 1998 Ringmaster PPV, 16 August, Boston) is revealed, mixing several already-minted wrestlers with several new names.
notes: One post, 25 May 1998. Extends the wing's own thrice-weekly Hot Spot record roughly five months past its own last-served December 1997 date, with no gap in format. A companion sampled post proved on inspection to be third-party bycatch about an unrelated federation (IeWC) merely mailed to an INWI address, not INWI's own content, and is not served.
